40014737.author: पदार्थः
40014737.content: राघवेण: by Raghava, अभये: promised security, दत्ते: given, रावाणानुजः to Ravana's brother, महाप्राज्ञः wise, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सन्नतः prepared to, भूमिम् ground, समवलोकयन् looked around.

40014737.author: Translation
40014737.content: When wise Vibheeshana, the brother of Ravana was assured of security by Raghava, he looked around the ground and prepared (to descend).

40014738.author: पदार्थः
40014738.content: धर्मात्मा: righteous self, सः that, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, हृष्टः happily, खात् from the sky, भक्तेः devotees, सहा: accompanied by, अवनिम् on to the land, पपातात: descended, रामस्य: towards Rama, निपपात: fell on the feet.

40014738.author: Translation
40014738.content: Righteous Vibheeshana descended from the sky and fell at the feet of Rama accompanied by his devotees happily (considering it to be inappropriate to come with foot down he came straight down with his body).

40014739.author: पदार्थः
40014739.content: अथ: thereafter, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चतुर्भिः and the four, राक्षसैःसह: along with Rakshasas, पादयोः by foot, शरणान्वेषी: who seeks shelter, निपपात: prostrated falling down, रामंप्रति: in front of Rama, धर्मयुक्तम् duly expressing his duty, युक्तंच: and appropriate, साम्प्रतम् placing confidence in, सम्प्रहर्षणम् showing extreme joy, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीच्च: spoken.

40014739.author: Translation
40014739.content: Thereafter Vibheeshana and the four Rakshasas who sought shelter prostrated lying at the feet of Rama expressing their duty, duly and placing confidence in Rama who spoke these words showing extreme joy.

40014740.author: पदार्थः
40014740.content: अहम् I am, रावणस्य: Ravana's, अनुजः younger brother, तेन: having been, अवमानितश्च: put to shame, सर्वभूतानाम् all beings, शरण्यम् protector, भवन्तम् you are, शरणागतः came to seek protection.

40014740.author: Translation
40014740.content: "I am Ravana's younger brother. Having been put to shame I came to seek protection from you who are the protector of all beings " (Vibheeshana said to Rama)."

40014741.author: पदार्थः
40014741.content: मया: my, लङ्का: Lanka, परित्यक्ता: leaving, मित्राणिच: and friends, धनानिच: even wealth, मे: my, राज्यम् kingdom, भवद्गतंहि: at your disposal, जीवितम् life, सुखानिच: for happiness.

40014741.author: Translation
40014741.content: "Leaving Lanka, my friends and my wealth I came to you. Now my life, kingdom and welfare are at your disposal."

40014742.author: पदार्थः
40014742.content: रामः Rama, तस्य: that, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा: on hearing, वचसा: word, एनम् that way, सान्त्वयित्वा: soothing him, लोचनाभ्याम् with both eyes, पिबन्निव: as if drinking, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoken, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, बलाबलम् strength as well as weakness, मम: to me, तत्त्वेन: truly, आख्याहि: related.

40014742.author: Translation
40014742.content: "On hearing those words (of Vibheeshana) that were soothing to him as if he drank (Vibheeshana's love) with his both eyes, Rama asked Vibheeshana to truly relate the strength as well as weakness of the Rakshasas."

40014743.author: पदार्थः
40014743.content: रामः Rama, तस्य: that, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा: on hearing, वचसा: word, एनम् that way, सान्त्वयित्वा: soothing him, लोचनाभ्याम् with both eyes, पिबन्निव: as if drinking, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoken, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, बलाबलम् strength as well as weakness, मम: to me, तत्त्वेन: truly, आख्याहि: related.

40014743.author: Translation
40014743.content: "On hearing those words (of Vibheeshana) that were soothing to him as if he drank (Vibheeshana's love) with his both eyes, Rama asked Vibheeshana to truly relate the strength as well as weakness of the Rakshasas."

40014744.author: पदार्थः
40014744.content: तदा: then, अक्लिष्टकिर्मणा: of unwearied action, रामेण: by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तम् having said, रक्षः Rakshasa (Vibheeshana), रावणस्य: Ravana's, सर्वम् all, बलम् strength, आख्यातुम् to speak out, उपचक्रमे: proceeded.

40014744.author: Translation
40014744.content: Then the Rakshasa (Vibheeshana) having heard that Rama of unwearied action would save him proceeded to speak out about the strength of Ravana.

40014745.author: पदार्थः
40014745.content: राजपुत्र: prince, स्वयंभुवः selfborn Brahma, वरदानात्: by virtue of a boon, दशग्रीवः tenheaded Ravana, गन्धर्वोररक्षसाम् by Gandharvas, serpents or Rakshasas, सर्वभूतानाम् by all beings, अवध्यः not possible to kill.

40014745.author: Translation
40014745.content: "Oh Prince, by virtue of a boon granted by Brahma, the selfborn to the tenheaded Ravana, he cannot be killed by Gandharvas, Rakshasas and by all beings."

40014746.author: पदार्थः
40014746.content: रावणानन्तरः younger to Ravana, भ्राता: brother, मम: my, ज्येष्ठश्च: elder's, वीर्यवान् highly valiant, महातेजा: of great prowess, कुम्बकर्णः Kumbhakarna, युधि: in war, शक्रप्रतिबलः equal to Indra in strength.

40014746.author: Translation
40014746.content: "My elder brother, the one who is younger to Ravana is a highly valiant one endowed with great prowess. He is Kumbhakarna and equal to Indra in war."

40014747.author: पदार्थः
40014747.content: राम: Rama, येन: on which account, कैलासे: in Kailasa, सङ्ग्रामे: in combat, मणिभद्रः Manibhadra, पराजितः defeated, तस्यसेनापतिः his army chief, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, ते: you, श्रुतःयदि: might have heard.

40014747.author: Translation
40014747.content: "Rama You might have heard of Prahastha who the commander in chief of his (Ravana's) army is by whom Manibhadra (Kubera's Commander of Army) was defeated in a comb at in Kailas (the abode of Siva)."

40014748.author: पदार्थः
40014748.content: यः he who, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, बुद्धगोधाङ्गुळित्रश्च: possessed with skin of Iguana on his hands, अवध्यकवचः shield which cannot be pierced, धनुः bow, आदाय: wielding, युधि: in combat, तिष्ठन् remains, अदृश्यः unseen, भवति: will be.

40014748.author: Translation
40014748.content: "He (Ravana's eldest son) who is possessed of Iguana skin on his hands (to protect), and with a shield that cannot be pierced and who remains unseen in comb at wielding a bow is Indrajith."

40014749.author: पदार्थः
40014749.content: राघव: Raghava, शत्रून् at enemies, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, हुताशनम् god of fire, तर्पयित्वा: by satisfying, अन्तर्धानगतः goes unseen, सुमयव्यूहे: when caught by network of foes, सङ्ग्रामसमये: at the time of war, हन्ति: strikes.

40014749.author: Translation
40014749.content: "Raghava Indrajith strikes when caught by a network of foes in war by becoming invisible because of satisfying fire god."

40014750.author: पदार्थः
40014750.content: महोदरमहापार्श्वौ: Mahodara and Mahaparsva, अकम्पनः Akampana, राक्षसश्च: at Rakshasas, युधि: in war, लोकपालसमाः like the guardians of the world, एते: all these are, तस्य: their, अनीकस्ध: commanders in the army.

40014750.author: Translation
40014750.content: "Mahodara, Mahaparsva, Akampana are Rakshasas who are like the guards of the world. They are the commanders of his (Ravana's) army."

40014751.author: पदार्थः
40014751.content: कामरूपिणाम् who change form at their will, मांसशोणितभक्ष्याणाम् who eat flesh and blood, लङ्कापुरनिवासिनाम् those residing in the city of Lanka, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, सहस्राणि: thousands.

40014751.author: Translation
40014751.content: "Thousands of Rakshasas inhabit the city of Lanka living on flesh and blood and changing their form at will."

40014752.author: पदार्थः
40014752.content: सः that, राजा king, तैः them (Rakshasas), सहितः accompanied by, लोकपालन् rulers of the world, अयोधय् unassailable, देवैःसहा: along with celestial beings, महात्मना: great soul, रावणे: by Ravana, भग्नाः shattered.

40014752.author: Translation
40014752.content: "The unassailable rulers of the world and even celestial beings have been shattered by Ravana accompanied by the Rakshasas."

40014753.author: पदार्थः
40014753.content: रामः Rama, दृढपराक्रमः one of mighty prowess, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा: hearing, सर्वम् everything, मनसा: in mind, अन्वीक्ष्य: examining, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40014753.author: Translation
40014753.content: Rama of mighty prowess having heard everything from Vibheeshana, examining in his mind, spoke.

40014754.author: पदार्थः
40014754.content: विभीषण: Vibheeshana, रावणस्य: Ravana's, यानि: those, कर्मापदानानि: actions followed, अख्यातानि: that which has been spoken, तानि: those, तत्त्वेन: in essence, अहम् अवगच्छामि: is known to me, हि: also.

40014754.author: Translation
40014754.content: "Vibheeshana Those actions resorted to by Ravana which have been spoken by you in essence are known to me."

40014755.author: पदार्थः
40014755.content: अहम् I, सप्रहस्तम् with Prahastha, सबान्धवः with relatives, दशग्रीवम् tenheaded Ravana, हत्वा: killing, त्वाम् you, राजानम् crown as the king, करिष्यामि: will make you, मे: my, एतत् this, सत्यम् true, ब्रवीमि: telling.

40014755.author: Translation
40014755.content: "By Killing the tenheaded Ravana along with Prahastha and relatives I will make you the king. I am telling you, this is true."

40014756.author: पदार्थः
40014756.content: रावणः Ravana, रसातलम् hell, पातालंवापि: even under the ground, प्रविशेत् if enters, पितामहासकाशंवा: or the abode of Brahma, जीवन् with life, मे: I, नविमोक्ष्यते: will not let.

40014756.author: Translation
40014756.content: "Even if Ravana enters the hell or underground or the abode of Brahma the creator, I will not let him be alive."

40014757.author: पदार्थः
40014757.content: सपुत्रजनबान्दवम् accompanied with sons and relatives and people, रावणम् Ravana, सङ् ख्ये: in war, अहत्वा: without putting an end to, अयोध्याम् into Ayodhya, नप्रवेक्ष्यामि: will not enter, तै: those, त्रिभिः three, भ्रातृभिः brothers, शपे vow.

40014757.author: Translation
40014757.content: "I vow upon my three brothers that I will not enter Ayodhya without putting an end to Ravana along with his people, sons and relatives."

40014758.author: पदार्थः
40014758.content: धर्मात्मा: righteous man, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः untiring in action, तस्यरामस्य: at Rama's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा: after having heard, शिरसा: with head, अवन्द्य: bent down, वक्तुमेव: to speak, उपचक्रमे: started.

40014758.author: Translation
40014758.content: After having heard the words of Rama of untiring in action, Vibheeshana of righteous nature, started to speak with his head bent down (in reverence).

40014759.author: पदार्थः
40014759.content: लङ्कायाः Lanka's, प्रधर्षणे: for storming, राक्षसानाम् for Rakshasas, वथे: for killing, साह्यम् help, करिष्यामि: will render, यथाप्राणम् with all my strength, वाहिनीम् army, प्रवेक्ष्यामिच: to enter.

40014759.author: Translation
40014759.content: "I will render assistance with all my strength for storming Lanka, for killing the Rakshasas and for the army to enter."

40014760.author: पदार्थः
40014760.content: रामस्तु: even Rama also, प्रीत: pleased, इति: thus, ब्रुवाणम् spoken, विभीषणम् by Vibheeshana, परिष्वज्य: embracing, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said, समुद्रात् from the ocean, जलम् water, आनय: get water.

40014760.author: Translation
40014760.content: When Vibheeshana had spoken in that manner, Rama was pleased and embraced him. He called for Lakshmana to get water from the ocean (for consecration).

40014761.author: पदार्थः
40014761.content: मानद: respectable one, मयि: I am, प्रसन्ने: pleased with, महाप्राज्ञम् highly intelligent, इमम् this, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, राजानम् crowned king, क्षीप्रम् at once, तेन: so, अभिषिञ्च: will coronate.

40014761.author: Translation
40014761.content: "I am pleased with this highly intelligent Vibheeshana, a respectable one. I will coronate him at once as king of Rakshasas."

40014762.author: पदार्थः
40014762.content: एवम् in that way, उक्ताः having spoken, सौमित्रि: Saumithri, वानमुख्यानाम् chiefs of army of Vanaras, मध्ये: midst, रामशासनात् by the command of Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, राजानम् as king, अभ्यषिञ्चत् coronated.

40014762.author: Translation
40014762.content: (Rama) having spoken that way, Saumithri crowned Vibheeshana as crowned king on the command of Rama amid Vanara army chiefs.

40014763.author: पदार्थः
40014763.content: प्लवङ्गमाः the leaping animals (Vanaras), रामस्य: Rama's, तम्: that, सद्यः that, प्रसादम् grace, दृष्टवा: seeing, प्रचुक्रुशुः moving about in joy, महात्मानम् great self, साधुसाधुइति: good, अब्रुवन् च: hailed saying.

40014763.author: Translation
40014763.content: At that instant the Vanaras jumped, moving about exhibiting their joy on witnessing great Rama's grace saying "Good, good."

40014764.author: पदार्थः
40014764.content: हनूमांश्च: Hanuman also, विभीषणम् to Vibheeshana, अब्रवीत् said, सुग्रीवश्च: to Sugriva, सर्वे: entire lot of, महौजसाम् highly energetic, वानराणाम् with Vanaras, सैन्यैः army, परिवृताः surrounded, अक्षोभ्यम् imperturbable, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna (ocean), सागरम् ocean, कथम् how, तराम: to cross.

40014764.author: Translation
40014764.content: Hanuman and Sugriva enquired of Vibheeshana as to how to cross this ocean that is imperturbable along with the entire lot of energetic Vanara army.

40014765.author: पदार्थः
40014765.content: नदनदीपतिम् Lord of rivers and streams, god of water, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna, ससैन्याः with the army, सर्वे: entire, तरसा: to cross, यथा: this way, तराम: to cross, उपायैः strategy, अभिगच्चाम: shall we approach.

40014765.author: Translation
40014765.content: "What strategy should we adopt to cross this abode of Varuna, the Lord of rivers and streams with the entire army of Vanaras?" (Hanuman and Sugriva asked Vibheeshana).

40014766.author: पदार्थः
40014766.content: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having said, धर्मात्मा: righteous self, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच: replied, राजा: O King, राघवः Raghava, समुद्रम् ocean, शरणम् refuge, गन्तुम् will go, अर्हति: we ought to.

40014766.author: Translation
40014766.content: (Hanuman) having asked so, righteous Vibheeshana said, "O king Raghava We ought to go and seek refuge from the god of the ocean."

40014767.author: पदार्थः
40014767.content: आप्रमेयः unbounded, अयम: this, महोदधिः great ocean, सगरेण: by Sagara, खनितः excavated, महामतिः king of the great ocean, ज्ञात: race, रामस्य: Rama's, कार्यम् task, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हति: ought to.

40014767.author: Translation
40014767.content: "This immeasurable great ocean was excavated by Sagara (A King of the Ikshvaku dynasty). The great ocean needs to do the task of Rama who is of the same race."

40014768.author: पदार्थः
40014768.content: अथ: and then, विपश्चिता: learned, राक्षसेना: by rakshasa, विभीषणेन: by Vibheeshana, एवम् in that manner, उक्तः having spoken, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सलक्ष्मणेन: accompanied by Lakshmana, रामः Rama, यत्र: where, आजगाम: reached.

40014768.author: Translation
40014768.content: Vibheeshana having spoken in that manner, Sugriva accompanied by Lakshmana reached near Rama.

40014769.author: पदार्थः
40014769.content: ततः thereafter, विपुलग्रीवः broadnecked, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words of advice, सागरस्य: about Sagara, उपवेशनम् sitting down, आख्यातुम् to make him know आरेभे: started.

40014769.author: Translation
40014769.content: Thereafter broadnecked Sugriva started to communicate to Rama the advice of Vibheeshana about Sagara.

40014770.author: पदार्थः
40014770.content: प्रकृत्या: by nature, धर्मशीलस्य: one who is of righteous character, अस्यरामस्यापि: to Rama also, रोचित: pleasing, महातेजाः brilliant, सः he, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, क्रियादक्षम् skilful at action, हरीश्वरम् king of Vanaras, सुग्रीवंच: and Sugriva also, सत्क्रियार्थम् about the task to be undertaken, स्मितपूर्वम् smilingly, उवाच: said.

40014770.author: Translation
40014770.content: To Rama who was by nature righteous the advice (of Vibheeshana) was pleasing. To the brilliant Lakshmana of skilful action, to Sugriva the king of monkeys, Rama said smilingly.

40014771.author: पदार्थः
40014771.content: प्रकृत्या: by nature, धर्मशीलस्य: one who is of righteous character, अस्यरामस्यापि: to Rama also, रोचित: pleasing, महातेजाः brilliant, सः he, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, क्रियादक्षम् skilful at action, हरीश्वरम् king of Vanaras, सुग्रीवंच: and Sugriva also, सत्क्रियार्थम् about the task to be undertaken, स्मितपूर्वम् smilingly, उवाच: said.

40014771.author: Translation
40014771.content: To Rama who was by nature righteous the advice (of Vibheeshana) was pleasing. To the brilliant Lakshmana of skilful action, to Sugriva the king of monkeys, Rama said smilingly.

40014772.author: पदार्थः
40014772.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, विभीषणस्य: Vibheeshana's, आयंमन्त्रः this advice, मम: to me,रोचते: pleasing, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, पण्डितः learned, भवान् me, नित्यम् ever, मन्त्रविशारद: capable of good advice, उभाभ्याम् for both, अर्थम् meaningful, सम्प्रधार्य: tradition, यत् that which, रोचते: appeals, तत् that, उच्यताम् may be told to me.

40014772.author: Translation
40014772.content: "Lakshmana This advice of Vibheeshana is pleasing to me. Sugriva is learned, and you are always capable of good advice. That which appeals to both of you, and which is meaningful may be informed to me."

40014773.author: पदार्थः
40014773.content: ततः then, एवम् that way, उक्तौ: having been said, वीरौ: heroic, सुग्रीवलक्ष्मणौ: to Sugriva and Lakshmana, उभौ: both, समुदाचारसंयुक्तम् mixed with respectful tradition, इदम् these, वचनम् words, ऊचतुः gave reply.

40014773.author: Translation
40014773.content: Heroic Rama having said that way to both, Lakshmana and Sugriva replied thus respectfully following tradition (with folded hands).

40014774.author: पदार्थः
40014774.content: नरव्याघ्र: tiger among kings, राघव: Raghava, अस्मिन् this, काले: time, सुखावहम् good, यत् that which, विभीषणेन: by Vibheeshana, उक्तम् has been spoken, नौ: us, किमर्थम् why will, नरोचिष्यति: it not be pleasing.

40014774.author: Translation
40014774.content: "O Raghava, the tiger among kings Why will this good advice given to us at this time by Vibheeshana be not pleasing?" Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama."

40014775.author: पदार्थः
40014775.content: घोरे: terrific, वरुणालये: ocean, अस्मिन् सागरे: over this ocean, सेतुम् bridge, अबध्वा: building, लङ्का: Lanka city, सेन्द्रैरपि: even for Indra, सुरासुरैरपि: for Suras and Asuras also, आसादितुम् to cross over, नशक्या: not possible.

40014775.author: Translation
40014775.content: Without building a bridge over this terrific ocean, the abode of Varuna, it is not possible to cross over to Lanka even for Indra, suras or Asuras.

40014776.author: पदार्थः
40014776.content: शूरस्य: valiant, विभीषणस्य: Vibheeshana's, वचः words of advice, यथार्थम् are true, क्रियताम् to execute, कालात्ययम् no use was ting time, कृत्वा: to do, अलम् it is enough, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, पुरीम् city, यथा: like that, सैन्येन: army, गच्छाम: to proceed, सागर: अयं: over th is ocean, नियुज्यताम् let us request.

40014776.author: Translation
40014776.content: "Valiant Vibheeshana's words are true. Let us proceed and let us not waste time. Let us request Sagara to help the army to be able to proceed to Lanka ruled by Ravana (Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama)."

40014777.author: पदार्थः
40014777.content: शूरस्य: valiant, विभीषणस्य: Vibheeshana's, वचः words of advice, यथार्थम् are true, क्रियताम् to execute, कालात्ययम् no use was ting time, कृत्वा: to do, अलम् it is enough, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, पुरीम् city, यथा: like that, सैन्येन: army, गच्छाम: to proceed, सागर: अयं: over th is ocean, नियुज्यताम् let us request.

40014777.author: Translation
40014777.content: "Valiant Vibheeshana's words are true. Let us proceed and let us not waste time. Let us request Sagara to help the army to be able to proceed to Lanka ruled by Ravana (Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama)."

40014778.author: पदार्थः
40014778.content: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having said, रामः Rama, तदा: then, नदनदीपतेः ocean, कुशास्तीर्णे: on the Kusa grass mat, तीरे: shore, हुताशन: fire God, वेद्यामिव: like in the sacrificial altar, संविवेश: sat.

40014778.author: Translation
40014778.content: Then when they (Sugriva and Lakshmana) said so to Rama, he sat on Kusa grass mat on the shore of the ocean just as fire stayed in the sacrificial altar. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the nineteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
